task: immediate dominator / must-pass upstream lineage analysis

core.signature: analyze(n: int, root: int, edges: Iterable[Sequence[int]]) -> list[Optional[int]]
core.returns: length-n list; result[root]=root; None if unreachable from root; otherwise the immediate (direct) dominator of v

input_contract.allowed: directed cycles, self loops, parallel edges; edges is only read, never modified

core.algorithm: Lengauer-Tarjan immediate dominators with path compression; iterative (explicit-stack) DFS and iterative evaluate(), so no recursion-limit dependence

complexity.time: O((n + len(edges)) log(n + len(edges) + 2))  [Lengauer-Tarjan near-linear bound, also within O((n+m) log n)]

forbidden_techniques_not_used: storing the full dominator set of every node
raising the recursion limit to survive long chains

covers: structural cases: cycles, unreachable regions, entry back edges, self loops, parallel edges, long chain n=20000
maximum chain n=200000 run with sys.setrecursionlimit(100), and root placed mid-chain
exhaustive cross-check against the vertex-deletion reference for every graph with n<=4 and <=4 edges, every root (10870 cases)
4000 sampled graphs with n=5..7 vs the vertex-deletion reference
60 random medium graphs (n<=120) vs independent bitset dataflow reference
API contract (n=1, isolated root, generator input, input not mutated)
scale run n=200000 with 500000 edges, reporting time and peak memory
adversarial deep-path case: 100000-node chain plus a back edge from the last node to every rootward node (n=100000, m=199998)

lineage_demo.covers: realistic warehouse lineage graph with a dbt-style circular dependency, a redundant side-door edge, an entry back edge, an unreachable orphan pipeline and a 40-node linear tail; prints idom vs naive BFS parent per artifact and audits every reported idom by vertex deletion

deletion_reference_only.command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "from reference_dominance import brute_force_idom as b; print(b(5,0,[(0,1),(0,2),(1,3),(2,3)]))"

reference_checks.brute_force_idom: definitional check for small graphs: u strictly dominates v iff deleting u makes v unreachable from root; immediate dominator is the strict dominator whose strict-dominator set is exactly one smaller (strict dominators form a chain)
reference_checks.bitset_idom: iterative dominator dataflow over Python integer bitsets; independent of DFS numbering, semidominators and path compression; used for medium graphs
reference_checks.dominates: single-pair definitional predicate used to audit reported answers

scale_input.structure: 50000-node linear chain 0->1->...->49999, plus 450001 random edges whose targets start at node 50000 so chain answers stay exact
